Decide a batch of corrections

Source: R/source_corrections.R
decide_corrections.Rd

Records accept, reject, supersede or bake for each row of decisions. A correction applies while its latest decision is accept. When two accepted corrections to a cell disagree, neither applies (G1): supersede the wrong one to settle the cell.

Usage

decide_corrections(config, con, decisions, dry_run = TRUE, dialect = "mssql")

Arguments

config

A master_config from read_master_config(), with sources and deciders.

con

A DBI connection to the warehouse.

decisions

A data frame with source, correction_id, decision, decided_by and optionally reason.

dry_run

If TRUE, the default, validate only.

dialect

"mssql" or "duckdb".

Value

Invisibly, a list: verdicts (a data frame of row, verdict) and recorded (an integer).

Details

Each row gets one of these verdicts:

  • recordable: the row passed every check below.

  • unknown_source: the source is not declared in master.yml.

  • repeated_correction: the batch decides the same correction more than once. Every row of a batch shares one decided_on, so their order would be arbitrary; decide it again in a later batch instead.

  • unknown_correction: the source has no correction with that id.

  • invalid_decision: the decision is not one of the four.

  • not_decider: the decider is not listed in master.yml's deciders.

  • self_accepted: the decider asserted the correction (G2).

With dry_run = FALSE, an all-recordable batch is recorded in one transaction, and a batch with any other verdict is refused whole.

Interim. Superseded by the HVTR registry. Replaces the deprecated decide_correction().

See also

propose_corrections(), retire_filled_corrections()
